name: Gloves
description: Safe OpenClaw-native metadata and approval tools for a host-local gloves runtime.

root.description: Host path to the gloves runtime root.

glovesBin.description: Optional absolute host path to the gloves CLI when it is not already on the Gateway PATH.

operatorAgentId.description: Optional operator identity used for audit attribution when the plugin approves or denies requests.

cwd.description: Optional working directory for spawned gloves CLI commands.
